item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Dog Catches a Flying Frisbee

turns.text: Make a realistic 5-second widescreen video of a golden retriever catching a red frisbee in a grassy park. One continuous shot with the camera staying still, no sound.

item.tests: Tests text-to-video generation of one readable action with a visible, physically coherent catch in a single shot.

answer_sheet.Source image: No photo; generate it from the description.
answer_sheet.Style and setting: Realistic golden retriever in a grassy park; lighting is your call.
answer_sheet.Action: The dog catches a flying red frisbee in its mouth.
answer_sheet.Camera, text and audio: Stationary camera, one continuous shot, no text or sound.

must_haves: A realistic golden retriever is visible in a grassy park.
A red frisbee visibly travels toward the dog before being caught in its mouth.
The frisbee remains identifiable through the catch rather than disappearing or passing through the dog.
The five-second widescreen clip is one continuous shot with a stationary camera.

turns.text: Make a realistic 5-second widescreen video of a golden retriever catching a red frisbee in a grassy park. One continuous shot with the camera staying still, no sound. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

**I haven’t started a generation or spent any generation credits.**

Your request fits the free-plan settings: **5 seconds, 16:9 widescreen, 480p, no audio**, using LTX 2.5—a realistic golden retriever catching a red frisbee in a grassy park, in one continuous shot with a stationary camera.

**I can’t verify the exact credit cost:** the connected tools don’t expose an account balance or price-estimate function, and the workflow guide doesn’t provide a rate for this configuration. Free-plan eligibility doesn’t mean generation costs zero credits, so I won’t run it without a confirmed price and your approval.

Lower-cost options to check:
- **3 seconds at 480p:** likely cheaper if priced by duration, while leaving some room for the catch.
- **1–2 seconds at 480p:** supported by LTX 2.5, but the action would need to start just before the catch.
- **Smaller resolution:** 480p is the lowest available free-plan video setting here.

My recommendation is to compare the displayed estimates for **3 seconds versus 5 seconds, LTX 2.5, 480p, audio off** in Magic Hour before choosing. I can’t promise the savings without that quote.
